title: USB drive not recognised
symptom: USB drive does not appear when plugged in
user_description: I plugged in my USB drive with my documents and nothing shows up. Please don't delete my files!

options.why: Formatting erases everything on the drive. Never format a drive that holds someone's files as a first step.

options.text: Try a different USB port, and then another PC, to see whether the drive or the port is at fault
options.why: Testing another port and another computer quickly shows whether the problem is the port, the PC or the drive itself, without risking any data.
Very destructive and almost never needed for a USB drive that does not show up.

options.text: Tell her the files are lost
options.why: Incorrect and unhelpful. Nobody has tested the drive yet, so there is no reason to assume the data is gone.

hints: Is the problem the drive, the port or the PC? How could you find out?
What would be the worst thing to do to someone's data?
real_world_tip: Many companies limit which USB drives can be used. Check your company's policy before plugging in a drive you don't recognise.
